definitions: A mod for the video game Minecraft that adds a magic system based on thaumaturgy, allowing players to manipulate aura, essentia, and other magical elements to create items, cast spells, and perform rituals.
The practice or study of the magic system introduced by the Thaumcraft mod in Minecraft.
examples: Many players enjoy the complexity of Thaumcraft.
He spent hours delving into the secrets of Thaumcraft.
The latest update to Thaumcraft introduced new golems.
